name: Day Camp in the Park
description_short: Day camp on Lake Tiorati in Harriman State Park since 1979 for ages 4 to 14, with daily Red Cross swim lessons in a heated pool or the lake, boating, hiking, nature, sports, arts and theater taught by adult staff. Girls' and boys' groups run by grade, with a Nursery group for 4 and 5 year olds and a CIT program for 15 year olds.
refund_policy_summary: The $500 deposit is fully refundable until April 1, 2027; no refunds after that date for any reason.

sessions.name: All 8 weeks (no camp July 5 or August 20)

fees.name: Late payment fee
fees.note: Charged per camper if the balance is not paid in full by April 15, 2027

fees.name: Changes after June 1
fees.note: Charged for extensions or changes made after June 1, 2027

notes: 2027 regular tuition (ages 4 to 14), door to door air conditioned busing included: 8 weeks $7,300, any 7 weeks $7,100, any 6 weeks $6,800, any 5 weeks $6,200, any 4 weeks $5,400, weeks 1 to 4 or 5 to 8 $5,000. Early bird rates ($600 less) ended September 30, 2026. Four week minimum. $500 deposit per camper goes toward tuition. Sibling discount $500 per family. CITs (age 15, entering 10th) get $50 a week off. Credit card payments carry a 4% surcharge.

warnings: Camp sits in Harriman State Park with a Southfields (Orange County) mailing address, not in Rockland County proper; the camp markets to Rockland and NYC families.
